name: Adrenaline Boost's Adrenaline makes the next Bloodmoon Blast instant (#2208)
contract: Adrenaline Boost 680675 effect 1 is aura 42 SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL on Adrenaline 680678, with Spell.dbc ProcFlags 0 and ProcChance 50. SpellMgr::LoadSpellProcs skips auto-generating an entry for a record without proc flags (SpellMgr.cpp:2249), so Aura::GetProcEffectMask returned 0 and the aura could never fire; the migration adds the spell_proc row (melee auto attacks plus melee-class spells, critical hits only, 50%). 680678's payload is sound: aura 108 ADD_PCT_MODIFIER, MiscValue 10 (SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME), BasePoints -101 / DieSides 1 = -100%, class mask (0, 10240, 0) = Bloodmoon Blast + Dark Liturgy, StackAmount 1 - 'your next Dark Liturgy or Bloodmoon Blast is instant cast'. 572332 is the Bloodmoon Blast rank a level-80 character owns per AscensionSpellProgressionData.h and carries CastingTimeIndex 5, a real cast time. This scenario proves the payload contract only. The proc itself is gated on a melee critical strike, and the harness has no melee critical rating fixture and no forced melee critical, so no assertion here discriminates on the spell_proc row; that half needs a Ghost e2e run with a geared melee bot.

steps.label: Bloodmoon Blast cast time without Adrenaline
Bloodmoon Blast is not instant on its own
Adrenaline makes the next Bloodmoon Blast instant
Removing Adrenaline restores the cast time
